videos.title: Girlfriends: It's Been Determined
videos.overview: Joan (Tracee Ellis Ross) unexpectedly proposes to Aaron (guest star Richard T. Jones), but when he stumbles on his response, Joan decides the relationship is over and walks away.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Range of Emotions
videos.overview: When Joan buys an expensive new kitchen range for their new house, her fiance Aaron gets upset that she spent money without discussing it with him.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Baghdad, My Bad
videos.overview: In order to prevent Aaron from going to Iraq, Joan kidnaps him and takes him to Mexico. In Mexico, Aaron explains to Joan that he cannot run away from the war and suggests they get married before he leaves.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Where Did Lynn-Digo?
videos.overview: When Lynn meets Xander, a cute student at UCLA, he asks her to perform at a rally raising awareness to save the environment. But when Lynn's manager gets her a gig at the House of Blues for the same day, she must decide where she will perform.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Losing It
videos.overview: Maya tries to avoid calls from her publisher when she experiences writer's block and is unable to complete her third book.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Good Grief
videos.overview: When Maya accuses Darnell of blaming her for the miscarriage, Joan and Lynn are worried that Maya is in denial and not allowing herself to grieve.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Spree to Free
videos.overview: Joan is convinced that Maya is not coping with the recent loss of her baby, and decides a little retail therapy will help her recover.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Snap Back
videos.overview: At a gathering to celebrate William and Monica's pregnancy, Maya makes a joke that the baby is hers. Worried that Maya is having trouble dealing with the loss of their baby, Darnell confronts Maya and learns that she has been taking pills to help her cope

videos.title: Girlfriends: Save the Last Dance
videos.overview: Lynn calls Joan, Maya, and William old after realizing they never go out anymore. They decide to prove Lynn wrong by joining her for a night on the town at a hot new club.

videos.title: Girlfriends: R-E-S-P-E-C-T, Find Out What It Means to William
videos.overview: When William begins to feel that he is not respected at work he considers leaving the firm, and Monica freaks out thinking that he won’t be able to support her and their new baby.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Deck the Halls With Bags and Folly
videos.overview: Joan joins a support group for people who have relatives serving in Iraq but is upset when she finds out they are not planning a holiday party due to financial restraints.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Adapt to Adopt
videos.overview: Maya and Darnell romanticize the idea of adopting until they attend a neighborhood group for people who have adopted children and are offered a baby girl to adopt.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Stand and Deliver
videos.overview: Joan goes to the school where Aaron used to teach in order to read a letter he sent to his former students. However, when Joan arrives, the students give her a hard time so Maya decides to use her street smarts to help Joan get through to the students.

videos.title: Girlfriends: What's Black-A-Lackin'?
videos.overview: Lynn gets upset when she learns that her record label is pushing back the release of her album to promote another artist, Chrisette Michele.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Toe Sucking
videos.overview: Four girlfriends: picky lawyer Joan, gold-digging real estate agent Toni, professional student Lynn, and Joan's headstrong assistant Maya get involved with each other's loves and lives, particularly after Toni starts dating Joan's ex.

videos.title: Girlfriends: One Night Stand
videos.overview: Joan, who hasn't had sex in a year, decides to have a one-night stand with handsome restaurateur Davis.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Hip-Ocracy
videos.overview: Joan, Toni, and Lynn decide to find dates on the Internet. When Joan meets Marcus she thinks he is too good to be true until she finds out he wears a girdle. Toni breaks it off with her date simply because he's too black.

videos.title: Girlfriends: I Pity The Fool
videos.overview: Joan's new boyfriend Marcus has been moving a bit too fast and she realizes her heart was not in the relationship in the first place.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Girlfrenzy
videos.overview: With Maya and Joan becoming close friends, Toni becomes jealous and feels she's losing her best friend.

videos.title: Girlfriends: The Importance of Being Frank
videos.overview: Joan starts dating her client's very attractive accountant Keith, only to be stalked by his estranged wife.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Everything Fishy Ain’t Fish
videos.overview: Joan learns that Maya's husband may be cheating on her and must face whether or not it's a good idea to tell her friend. Toni dates a City Councilman who can help further her career.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Never A Bridesmaid
videos.overview: Maya and her partner Darnell decide they want to renew their vows and have a formal wedding ceremony. Joan offers to help with the event and to have it at her home.

videos.title: Girlfriends: The Remains of the Date
videos.overview: Joan is determined to play the ultimate Halloween prank on William and succeeds. Meanwhile, Toni is left to deal with her dates strange sexual fetish for stuffed animals.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Fried Turkey
videos.overview: On a holiday that emphasizes togetherness, Joan struggles with feelings of loneliness and separation on Thanksgiving.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Pregnant Pause
videos.overview: Baby has never been in Joan's vocabulary until she gets the scare of her life and a new perspective on her priorities. As a result, the girls come together to give their love and support, showing their true Girlfriend friendship.

videos.title: Girlfriends: The List
videos.overview: Dreading another dateless weekend, the girls and William try Maya's suggestion to make a list of what they want in a mate.

videos.title: Girlfriends: They’ve Gotta Have It
videos.overview: Joan's new boyfriend Sean has not made a move on her after three weeks of dating and she is beginning to wonder why.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Bad Timing
videos.overview: Joan begins to question her relationship with Sean when he gives her a power drill for Valentine's and doesn't hear from him for three days.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Old Dog
videos.overview: Joan decides it is time to give in on her three-month rule and she is finally going to have sex with her boyfriend Sean.

videos.title: Girlfriends: The Declaration of Lynndependence
videos.overview: Joan and Toni decide that Lynn needs to learn to be independent. They give her a week to find a job, then she is on her own.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Friends, Colleagues, Brothers
videos.overview: Joan discovers that being the only black woman at her firm has many disadvantages and she is constantly ignored and overlooked.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Diss-regard
videos.overview: Maya checks into the hospital for her fibroid surgery and Joan has trouble managing her time between her boyfriend and her friends.

videos.title: Girlfriends: The Burning Vagina Monologues
videos.overview: Joan is stressing because Sean hasn't told her that he loves her.

videos.title: Girlfriends: A Kiss Before Lying
videos.overview: Sean notices that Joan always flirts with Davis. He gets jealous and tells Joan that she can never see Davis again or go back to 847.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
videos.overview: Joan opens her mouth and tells Greg about Toni and Clay.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Jamaic-Up?
videos.overview: Joan takes the girls to the Sinbad Music Festival to help ease Toni to get over her breakup with Greg.

videos.title: Girlfriends: The Fallout
videos.overview: The ladies return home from their very eventful trip to Jamaica where Joan unintentionally ruined Toni's relationship.

videos.title: Girlfriends: Just Say No
videos.overview: Joan continues to suffer in her troubled friendship with Toni and her new relationship with her therapist, Dr. Bales.

videos.title: Girlfriends: A Full Court Conspiracy
videos.overview: Torn between her two worlds, Joan struggles with her professional duty while at the same time dealing with the guilt that she is not being true to herself or her beliefs.
